SPIRITS-STRIKE_SPIRITS.title: Strike
SPIRITS-DEFEND_SPIRITS.title: Defend
SPIRITS-SPIRIT_BLADE.title: Spirit Blade
SPIRITS-SPIRIT_BLADE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {StaticGain:diff()} [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. Consume. Retain.
SPIRITS-ACTIVATE_FIRE_REMNANT.title: Activate Fire Remnant
SPIRITS-ACTIVATE_FIRE_REMNANT.descriptio: Gain [gold]Flash[/gold] equal to your [gold]Fire Remnant[/gold] stacks. Retain. Consume.
SPIRITS-RETURN_IT_IN_KIND.title: Return It in Kind
SPIRITS-RETURN_IT_IN_KIND.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. Consume. If the enemy has Strength, apply Weak {WeakAmount:diff()}. If Dexterity, apply Vulnerable {VulnAmount:diff()}. If Block, deal {BlockMult:diff()}x their Block as bonus damage.
SPIRITS-EARTHSHATTER.title: Earthshatter
SPIRITS-THUNDER_CLAP.title: Thunder Clap
SPIRITS-THUNDER_CLAP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Apply Weak {WeakPower:diff()}.
SPIRITS-SEVEN_WOUNDS_FIST.title: Seven-Wounds Fist
SPIRITS-GEOMAGNETIC_GRIP.title: Geomagnetic Grip
SPIRITS-GEOMAGNETIC_GRIP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply Weak 1. [Apply Weak 3 instead].
SPIRITS-PERFECT_JADE.title: Perfect Jade
SPIRITS-BOULDER_SMASH.title: Boulder Smash
SPIRITS-RESONANT_PULSE.title: Resonant Pulse
SPIRITS-RESONANT_PULSE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the damage dealt. [gold]Void[/gold].
SPIRITS-PULSE_CARD.title: Pulse
SPIRITS-PULSE_CARD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deal bonus damage equal to your [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-DISSIMILATE.title: Dissimilate
SPIRITS-SOARING_STRIKE.title: Soaring Strike
SPIRITS-SOARING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. End your turn. Gain 2 Energy at the start of your next turn.
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_STRIKE.title: Drunken Strike
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_STRIKE.description: Swap your Strength and Dexterity. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
SPIRITS-ROLLING_STRIKE.title: Rolling Strike
SPIRITS-ROLLING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you drew a card this turn, refund 1 Energy.
SPIRITS-REKINDLE.title: Rekindle
SPIRITS-REKINDLE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Heal HP equal to the damage dealt. [gold]Flash[/gold] 3. Consume.
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ZHAO.title: Return to Zhao
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ZHAO.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this kills, gain {StoneGain:diff()} [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold]. Otherwise, gain {BranchBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIRITS-DOUBLE_IMPACT.title: Double Impact
SPIRITS-DOUBLE_IMPACT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Return a random Attack from your discard pile to your hand. [gold]Flash[/gold] 2.
SPIRITS-SHATTERING_STRIKE.title: Shattering Strike
SPIRITS-SHATTERING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Consume 2 random cards in your hand. [gold]Void[/gold].
SPIRITS-HARDENED_STRIKE.title: Hardened Strike
SPIRITS-SLEIGHT_OF_FIST.title: Sleight of Fist
SPIRITS-SLEIGHT_OF_FIST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. Deals double damage in Elite rooms.
SPIRITS-SHADOWLESS_KICK.title: Shadowless Kick
SPIRITS-SHADOWLESS_KICK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. Deals double damage in normal rooms.
SPIRITS-ION_SEVER.title: Ion Sever
SPIRITS-ION_SEVER.description: Deal 7 damage. Gain [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] equal to the damage dealt. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-DANCE_OF_SHADOWS.title: Dance of Shadows
SPIRITS-DANCE_OF_SHADOWS.description: Deal 9 damage. Draw 1 card for every 5 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-ETHEREAL_IMPACT.title: Ethereal Impact
SPIRITS-ETHEREAL_IMPACT.description: Deal 1 damage. Apply 1 Intangible to the enemy and yourself. [gold]Void[/gold]. [Cost 2 → 1].
SPIRITS-EARTHBREAKER.title: Earthbreaker
SPIRITS-EARTHBREAKER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {PlatedArmor:diff()} Plated Armor. Apply Vulnerable 1. Draw 1 card. [Repeat once].
SPIRITS-NONLOCALITY.title: Nonlocality
SPIRITS-NONLOCALITY.description: Remove your Etherealized state and all negative statuses. Retain. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-BEDROCK.title: Bedrock
SPIRITS-BEDROCK.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Stone Remnant[/gold] triggers do not consume [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold] this turn. !Consume.
SPIRITS-LAYERED_ROCK.title: Layered Rock
SPIRITS-SOLID_ROCK.title: Solid Rock
SPIRITS-SOLID_ROCK.description: Innate. Gain 6 Plated Armor. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [Gain 16 [gold]Block[/gold] instead].
SPIRITS-MAGNETIZE.title: Magnetize
SPIRITS-MAGNETIZE.description: Consume all [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold]. For each stack consumed: gain X Plated Armor and 1 Energy. [Gain X+1 instead].
SPIRITS-PETRIFYING_HEX.title: Petrifying Hex
SPIRITS-PETRIFYING_HEX.description: Apply Weak {Weak:diff()} and Vulnerable {Vuln:diff()} to all enemies. Gain {StoneGain:diff()} [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-EMBER_BREW.title: Ember Brew
SPIRITS-SMOKE_CLEARS.title: Smoke Clears
SPIRITS-EMBER_PACT.title: Ember Pact
SPIRITS-EMBER_PACT.description: Consume a card from your hand. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. Consume.
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT_CARD.title: Fire Remnant
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT_CARD.description: Gain {FireGain:diff()} [gold]Fire Remnant[/gold]. If you have no Activate Fire Remnant in hand, add one.
SPIRITS-IN_AN_INSTANT.title: In an Instant
SPIRITS-GLIDING_SHADOW.title: Gliding Shadow
SPIRITS-ELECTRIC_VORTEX.title: Electric Vortex
SPIRITS-ELECTRIC_VORTEX.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply Vulnerable 1 to an enemy. Gain 3 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-WATER_WEARS_STONE.title: Water Wears Stone
SPIRITS-BULWARK.title: Bulwark
SPIRITS-BULWARK.description: Gain {StaticGain:diff()} [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE_CARD.title: Real Phase
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE_CARD.description: Gain 3 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. Your next [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] trigger deals double damage. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE_CARD.title: Imaginary Phase
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE_CARD.description: Gain 3 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. Your next [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] trigger does not consume. [gold]Void[/gold]. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-WIND_FILLS_TOWER.title: Wind Fills Tower
SPIRITS-BY_THEIR_STRENGTH.title: By Their Strength
SPIRITS-BY_THEIR_STRENGTH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Void[/gold]. If you take damage this turn, add a Return It in Kind to your hand.
SPIRITS-ROLLING_BOULDER.title: Rolling Boulder
SPIRITS-ROLLING_BOULDER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy. [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. Draw 1 card. [Draw 3 instead].
SPIRITS-RECTIFY.title: Rectify
SPIRITS-RECTIFY.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. Discard your hand and reshuffle your discard pile. Gain 1 Energy. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SPIRITS-FLAME_SHIELD.title: Flame Shield
SPIRITS-FLAME_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Whenever you are attacked, deal {RetaliationDmg:diff()} damage to the attacker.
SPIRITS-SUNFIRE_LASH.title: Sunfire Lash
SPIRITS-SUNFIRE_LASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to 3 random enemies. Apply Weak 2.
SPIRITS-SACRIFICIAL_HEART.title: Sacrificial Heart
SPIRITS-SACRIFICIAL_HEART.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. At the end of each turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
SPIRITS-ENERGIZE.title: Energize
SPIRITS-SHADOW_MAKES_THREE.title: Shadow Makes Three
SPIRITS-SPOT_THE_OPENING.title: Spot the Opening
SPIRITS-SPOT_THE_OPENING.description: If an enemy intends to attack, gain {Dex:diff()} Dexterity and [gold]Flash[/gold] 1.
SPIRITS-ASTRAL_STEP.title: Astral Step
SPIRITS-ASTRAL_STEP.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. Add 2 Spirit Blades to your hand.
SPIRITS-RESONANCE.title: Resonance
SPIRITS-RESONANCE.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. When you play your next card, draw all cards of the same rarity from your draw pile and discard pile.
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ORIGIN.title: Return to Origin
SPIRITS-RETURN_TO_ORIGIN.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. Repeatedly consume [gold]Flash[/gold] 1, [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold] 2, and [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] 4 in order until you cannot. Gain 1 Intangible per complete cycle. [Cost 2 → 1].
SPIRITS-POLISH_JADE.title: Polish Jade
SPIRITS-POLISH_JADE.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. Choose 1 of 3 random non-colorless cards from other classes. It costs 0 this turn. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-AETHER_REMNANT.title: Aether Remnant
SPIRITS-CRAVING.title: Craving
SPIRITS-CRAVING.description: Lose 3 HP. Draw 2 cards. Gain 1 Energy. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-EVER_FIRM.title: Ever Firm
SPIRITS-EVER_FIRM.description: Gain {PlatedArmor:diff()} Plated Armor and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [+{BlockBonus} [gold]Block[/gold]]. Return this card to your hand at the start of your next turn.
SPIRITS-BALL_LIGHTNING.title: Ball Lightning
SPIRITS-BALL_LIGHTNING.description: Deal 3X damage to an enemy. Draw X cards. Refund 1 Energy per Attack drawn. [X+1 when upgraded].
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_FIST.title: Drunken Fist
SPIRITS-DRUNKEN_FIST.description: Lose 1 HP and gain 2 Dexterity and 2 Strength, X times. [X+1 when upgraded].
SPIRITS-GRAY_FLY.title: Gray Fly
SPIRITS-THOUSAND_CRAGS.title: Thousand Crags
SPIRITS-THOUSAND_CRAGS.description: At the end of your turn, gain {StoneGain:diff()} [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-STONE_CORE.title: Stone Core
SPIRITS-BOULDER_FORM.title: Boulder Form
SPIRITS-BOULDER_FORM.description: Etherealize. Become immune to Vulnerable, Frail, and Weak. Consume all [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold] and gain Block equal to 8x, Plated Armor equal to 4x, and Strength equal to 2x that amount. Retain.
SPIRITS-CRYSTALLIZATION.title: Crystallization
SPIRITS-CRYSTALLIZATION.description: Innate. Your Plated Armor gains +1 at the end of turn instead of -1.
SPIRITS-EMBER_FORM.title: Ember Form
SPIRITS-EMBER_FORM.description: Etherealize. At the start of each turn, draw 1 card and gain [gold]Flash[/gold] 1. Gain [gold]Flash[/gold] 1.
SPIRITS-IONIZATION.title: Ionization
SPIRITS-IONIZATION.description: Innate. After [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] trigger, gain 4 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-STORM_FORM.title: Storm Form
SPIRITS-STORM_FORM.description: Etherealize. Your Energy cap becomes 1. Drawing a card sets your Energy to 1. When your Energy is 0, playing a card draws 1 card.
SPIRITS-EVER_CHANGING.title: Ever Changing
SPIRITS-EVER_CHANGING.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. At the end of your turn, attempt in order: spend 4 [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold] to gain [gold]Flash[/gold] 2; spend [gold]Flash[/gold] 2 to gain 8 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]; spend 8 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] to gain 4 [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold]. Stop after one success. [Cost 1 → 0].
SPIRITS-UNIFIED_FIELD_THEORY.title: Unified Field Theory
SPIRITS-UNIFIED_FIELD_THEORY.description: Innate. [gold]Void[/gold]. At the start of your turn, randomly gain [gold]Flash[/gold] 1, 2 [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold], or 4 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-VOID_FORM.title: Void Form
SPIRITS-VOID_FORM.description: Etherealize. Cards in your hand without [gold]Void[/gold] gain [gold]Void[/gold]. Cards with [gold]Void[/gold] lose it.
SPIRITS-ELEMENTAL_SEPARATION.title: Elemental Separation
SPIRITS-ELEMENTAL_SEPARATION.description: Innate. Etherealize. At the start of each turn, add 4 cards to your hand — one each containing [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold], [gold]Flash[/gold], [gold]Static Remnants[/gold], and [gold]Void[/gold].
SPIRITS-READ_THE_FOE.title: Read the Foe
SPIRITS-READ_THE_FOE.description: If you took no damage last turn, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy at the start of your turn.
SPIRITS-INTRINSIC_ADVANTAGE.title: Intrinsic Advantage
SPIRITS-ENTANGLEMENT.title: Entanglement
SPIRITS-ENTANGLEMENT.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. Whenever you gain [gold]Flash[/gold], [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold], or [gold]Static Remnants[/gold], also gain {Dex:diff()} temporary Dexterity.
SPIRITS-UNFETTERED.title: Unfettered
SPIRITS-UNFETTERED.description: Innate. You may play Curse and Status cards. They are Consumed.
SPIRITS-DROWN_SORROW.title: Drown Sorrow
SPIRITS-DROWN_SORROW.description: Innate. Whenever you take damage during your turn, if your HP is below 50%, heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD_POWER.title: Overload
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD_POWER.description: Innate. After playing a Skill, gain 1 Overload. Overload cap equals your Overload stacks.
SPIRITS-VOID_ECHO.title: Void Echo
SPIRITS-VOID_ECHO.description: [gold]Void[/gold]. At the start of your turn, return 1 random card from the Consumed pile to your hand. [Cost 2 → 1].
